module: Flowgraph node "Set Time of Day" (category dynamic_instant). Sets the time of day via core_environment.setTimeOfDay. Input pins: flow, time (0 to 1; 0 = midday, 0.25 evening, 0.5 midnight, 0.75 morning), play (bool, play or pause the cycle), dayLength (hidden, duration of a full cycle in real seconds).
notes: Sets mgr.modules.mission.todChanged = true so that the mission module knows the time has been changed.
data.restoreTod = true is defined but _executionStarted/_executionStopped are empty: nothing is restored by this node.

postInit.desc: Configures the time pin (0 to 1 slider, Midday/Evening/Midnight/Morning templates).

work.desc: In repeat mode, applies the time every frame.

setTimeOfDay.desc: Marks todChanged then calls core_environment.setTimeOfDay({time, play, dayLength}).
